name: 73507 · Lawton, OK
findings: ZIP 73507 (Lawton) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73507 (Lawton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73507 (Lawton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
